title: Best-Day Recipe Scorecard
dataSources: Daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`), personal SLO status (`personalslo:status`), cross-signal correlations (`correlation:pair`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The meta layer — correlating every `index=personal` feed (sleep, activity, mood, weather, spend, productivity, home telemetry) into daily life scores, personal SLOs, and cross-signal anomaly detection, all computed in Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifescore:daily
| where score>=8
| stats avg(sleep_score) as sleep_score, avg(activity_score) as activity_score, avg(focus_score) as focus_score, count as great_days
description: Summarises the ingredients that tend to show up on your best-scoring days.
value: People often know their bad-day triggers better than their good-day recipe; this flips the focus.
implementation: Log daily life scores with contributor dimensions; aggregate the companion scores for top-performing days.
visualization: Single scorecard of the average contributor mix for great days.
grandmaExplanation: It compares what your best days tend to have in common, so you can build more of them on purpose.
